entries.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上发现了一些神秘现象。
entries.en: Some strange occurances have been spotted on [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上发现了一些神秘现象。
entries.en: Some strange occurances have been spotted on [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的迁徙森林会干扰我们殖民地的发展。如果我们想在这颗星球殖民，我们必须想办法解决这个问题。
entries.en: The migrating forests on [Root.GetName] are interfering with the development of our colony. A solution to this problem must be found if we are to prosper on this world.

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的一个地底异星文明正朝着我们的殖民地地表挖掘甬道。他们的数量和意图都是未知的，这对于我们殖民地来说可能是一个重大的威胁。
entries.en: An underground alien civilization on [Root.GetName] is tunneling towards our colony on the surface. Their numbers and intentions are unknown to us, and they could be a significant threat.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的一部分在几千年以前曾经被远古文明改造过，但由于未知原因，改造进程搁置了。其结果是这里变成了一个高度不稳定的气候系统和生物圈。我们已经找到了废弃的环境改造设备，必须决定应该做什么。
entries.en: [Root.GetName] was partly terraformed by someone thousands of years ago, but the process was interrupted for unknown reasons. The result is a highly unstable climate system and biosphere. We have located the abandoned terraforming equipment, and must decide what should be done with it.

entries.zh: 我们在沃陶姆星群内找到了一些史前古器物。沃陶姆是在大约1200万年前活跃的外星文明。虽然这个种族确切的外观已经遗失在时间的迷雾中，但我们从它们的废墟可以推断出，他们是长度约三至四米的类蠕虫环节动物。他们似乎主要通过身体节段的震动来进行沟通。\n\n如果我们能从他们的文明遗迹中找到足够的信息，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
entries.en: We have recovered artifacts from the Vultaum Star Assembly. They were an alien civilization that was active approximately 12 million years ago. Though their exact appearance has been lost in the mists of time, we have deduced from their ruins that they were worm-like annelids, roughly three to four meters in length. They seem to have communicated with each other primarily through vibrations carried along their segmented bodies.\n\nIf we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

entries.zh: 我们已经发现了沃陶姆文明母恒星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明母星系的秘密之前派科研船前去探索！
entries.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Vultaum home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

entries.zh: 我们已经找到了一些来自尤特帝国的史前古器物。他们是一种大约六百万年以前占据一部分星系的外星文明。在生理上，亚特人是一种非常大而扁平的节肢类动物。一个成年亚特的体型可以长到一百米，这使得两个或者三个以上的亚特乘坐同一艘飞船进行星际旅行是一件非常罕见的事情。\n\n如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
entries.en: We have recovered artifacts from the Yuht Empire. They were an alien civilization that inhabited a portion of the galaxy roughly six million years ago. Physically the Yuht were very large and flat arthropod analogues. A single individual could reach a length of nearly a hundred meters as an adult, and it was apparently exceedingly rare for more than two or three Yuht to travel aboard the same starship.\n\nIf we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

entries.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的尤特文明母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明母星系的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
entries.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Yuht home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

entries.zh: 我们已经找到了一些来自第一联盟的史前古器物。他们是一个大约两百万年以前和平共生的巨大外星种族邦联。在最终崩溃之前，第一联盟的国境已经囊括了很大的一部分星系。\n\n如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
entries.en: We have recovered artifacts from the First League. They were a large confederation of alien races that co-existed in relative peace roughly two million years ago. The First League's borders may have expanded to cover a significant portion of the galaxy before its eventual collapse.\n\nIf we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

entries.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的第一联盟首都恒星系的位置，他们的大参议院就在那里。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
entries.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the First League capital system, where their Great Senate was based. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

entries.zh: 我们已经找到了一些来自伊拉斯协约国的史前古器物。他们是一个大约一百万年以前统治一大片星系的星际政权。六肢哺乳动物伊拉斯人的免疫系统异常地脆弱，使其面对异星传染病时十分容易夭折。据称，伊拉斯人似乎是灭绝于一种称为贾沃疹的席卷全境的瘟疫。\n\n如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母星系的位置。
entries.en: We have recovered artifacts from the Irassian Concordat. They were an interstellar power that held sway over a portion of the galaxy a little over a million years ago. The six-limbed mammalian Irassians had unusually weak immune systems that made them especially vulnerable to alien diseases. Some sources claim the Irassians were rendered extinct by the Javorian Pox, a devastating plague that swept across their empire.\n\nIf we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

entries.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的伊拉斯母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
entries.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Irassian home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

entries.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]上找到了赛博勒克斯文明的一些史前古器物。他们是约60万年前控制部分星系的机械集群意识。他们的起源和确切的性质都笼罩在神秘的面纱中，但已知的是这个文明发动了一场针对全体有机智慧生命文明的战争。这场战争持续了好几个世纪，数以万亿计的生命死亡。\n\n如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
entries.en: We have recovered artifacts from the Cybrex on [From.GetName]. They were a linked machine consciousness that controlled this portion of the galaxy some 600,000 years ago. Their origins and exact nature are shrouded in mystery, but it is known that they launched a crusade against all sapient organic life that lasted centuries and left trillions dead.\n\nIf we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

entries.zh: 已回收赛博勒克斯遗物
我们发现了失落已久的赛博勒克斯母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
entries.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Cybrex home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

entries.zh: 早在掌握超光速旅行之前，我们从[Root.Capital.GetName]向邻近的恒星系发射了数个亚光速探测器。我们必须在它们落入敌人的手中之前先将他们回收。
entries.en: Several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] to neighboring systems before we had mastered FTL travel. They must be recovered before they fall into hostile hands.

entries.zh: 我们的外星生物学家敦促我们调查所有发现存在生物圈的星球。他们渴望更深入地了解星系中的各种外星生态系统。
entries.en: Our xenobiologists have urged us to survey any worlds with an active biosphere that we come across. They are eager to learn more about the diverse alien ecosystems found throughout the galaxy.

entries.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]的外太空生物博物馆发来请求，他们想请求帮助收集在各颗星球上鉴别出的一些稀有外星生命体。
entries.en: The Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Capital.GetName] has asked for help in the collection of several rare alien life forms that have been identified on various different worlds.

entries.zh: 自称“[radical_cult.GetName]”的极端组织正试图暗中颠覆我们，蛊惑民众信仰他们扭曲的教义。他们已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上历兵秣马了数世纪，他们的领袖现已逃往了外太空，以继续进行反对我们的运动。
entries.en: Members of an extremist cult calling themselves the "[radical_cult.GetName]" are seeking to undermine our government and subvert the populace to their twisted religion. After spending centuries quietly building up their strength on [Root.Capital.GetName], their leaders have now fled into space to continue their crusade against us.

entries.zh: 在动身探索星系之前，我们必须对[home_system.GetName]恒星系进行全面调查。我们必须完全了解自己的“后院”。
entries.en: Before venturing into the rest of the galaxy, we should conduct a full survey of the [home_system.GetName] system. Our own backyard must not be left unexplored.

entries.zh: 为了确保长期生存，[This.GetSpeciesName]物种需要扩张到[This.Capital.GetName]之外的地方去。建立我们的第一个殖民地，并在外星球的地表上插上[This.GetName]的旗帜。
entries.en: The [This.GetSpeciesName] species needs to spread beyond [This.Capital.GetName] to secure its long-term survival. Establish our first colony and plant the banner of the [This.GetName] on the surface of an alien world.

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的碰撞轨道上探测到了一颗体积巨大的小行星。必须在它撞击地面之前将它摧毁！
entries.en: A large asteroid has been detected on a collision course with [Root.GetName]. It must be destroyed before it impacts the surface!

entries.zh: 我们探测到了一个相对我们星系具有接近矢量的神秘亚空间信号群。看来马上有访客要来了……
entries.en: A mysterious cluster of subspace contacts has been detected on an approach vector with our galaxy. It would appear that we are about to receive visitors...

entries.zh: 我们的星系被一群贪婪的星际生物入侵了，他们意图吞食所有遇到的生命体。必须在这些索林原虫入侵者的数量超过我们之前消灭他们。
entries.en: Our galaxy has been invaded by a ravenous swarm of spacefaring creatures that seem intent on consuming all life in their path. The rampage of these Prethoryn invaders must be stopped before their numbers overwhelm us.

entries.zh: 我们的星系之中出现了巨大的空间织构裂痕，可作为连接其它次元的单向通道。奇怪的虚体飞船从中涌出，他们会从路上碰到的一切物体身上吸取能源，直到那不幸的物体失去一切能源为止。
entries.en: A massive tear in the fabric of space has appeared in our galaxy, acting as some sort of one-way conduit between our reality and another. Strange ethereal spacecraft are pouring in through this dimensional portal, and they seem to leech energy to lethal effect from those unfortunate enough to be caught in their path.
In search for odd radiation readings.

entries.zh: 方舟船将我们祖先带到这个[Root.Capital.GetName]星系，而风信子号则是我们的姐妹船。一个世纪以前，从地球出发的风信子号本来是应该跟随我们来到这里的。现在我们必须要搞清楚她到底怎么样了。
entries.en: The Hyacinth, a sister ship to the arkship that brought our ancestors to [Root.Capital.GetName], was meant to follow us here from Earth a century ago. We must find out what became of her.

entries.zh: 在我们境内侦测到奇怪的外星人出现，我们无法与其建立通讯通道。另外因为我们无法翻译他们的语言，目前只能静观其变。
entries.en: We have detected that the odd aliens, whose communication we cannot tap into, have appeared within our borders. Since it's impossible for us to translate their language we can only wait and see who they are and what they want.

entries.zh: 我们的一艘舰船迷失于虚境之中。
entries.en: One of our vessels has been lost to the Shroud.

entries.zh: 邪教信徒们已在[Root.Capital.GetName]上的一个秘密设施的建造一支小型舰队。在被我们发现之后他们驾驶着舰船逃向[hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName]。在它们造成更大的损伤之前必须将他们摧毁！
entries.en: The cultists have managed to build a small fleet of starships at a secret facility on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Upon discovery, the cultists fled in their ships to [hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName]. They must be destroyed before they can cause any more damage!

entries.zh: 我们在这个星系附近探测到了逃窜的邪教徒飞船的离子轨迹。最好进行大规模搜查。
entries.en: We have detected ion trails from fleeing cultist ships in the vicinity of this star system. It should be reconnoitered in force.

entries.zh: 我们终于找到了邪教徒舰船的来源——他们霸占了在[cult_planet.GetStarName]上的远古外星船坞！务必在这些极端分子有机会启动全部产能之前摧毁该太空设施。
entries.en: We have finally identified the source of the cultist ships - some kind of ancient alien shipyard that they have commandeered in the [cult_planet.GetStarName] system! This space installation must be destroyed before the fanatics have a chance to unlock its true potential.

entries.zh: 据说神出鬼没的邪教徒旗舰就在这片星系附近游荡。我们必须派遣重火力武装舰队来对付。
entries.en: The elusive cultist flagship is believed to be lurking somewhere within this star system. We should dispatch a heavily armed fleet to confront it.

entries.zh: 根据脱离的轨道和离开母恒星系的时间推测，其中一个遗失的亚光速探测器应该就在这个恒星系里的某处。
entries.en: Based on its outbound trajectory and the time since it departed our home system, we suspect that one of our missing sublight probes can be found somewhere inside this star system.

entries.zh: 其中一个遗失的亚光速探测器的离子航迹指向这个星系。
entries.en: An ion trail belonging to one of our missing probes leads to this system.

entries.zh: 敌人阻止我们靠近这个星系的亚空间探测器。
entries.en: Hostiles prohibit us from getting to the subspace probe in this system.

entries.zh: 根据当前目标矢量推测，那个即将到来的亚空间实体会在这些恒星系附近进入我们的星系。
entries.en: Given their current vector, we estimate that the approaching mass of subspace contacts will enter our galaxy somewhere in the vicinity of these star systems.

entries.zh: 为了寻找风信子号的下落，我们必须完全调查这些恒星系。方舟船的原始引擎应该会留下离子航迹。
entries.en: We need to complete surveys of these systems and look for signs of passage by the Hyacinth. The arkship's primitive engines may have left behind a residual ion trail.

entries.zh: 风信子号的离子航迹指向这个星系。我们必须赶快调查。
entries.en: The Hyacinth's ion trail has been tracked to this system. We must investigate.

entries.zh: 在[extradimensional_system.GetName]恒星系发现异次元体入侵者正源源不断地从一个传送门中出来。若不摧毁传送门，他们就会不断派来增援。
entries.en: The portal from which the extradimensional invaders are spilling forth has been detected in the [extradimensional_system.GetName] system. They will be able to continuously reinforce their numbers until it has been destroyed.

entries.zh: 第二个位面传送门在[second_portal_system.GetName]恒星系出现了。和第一个一样，敌对异次元体舰船源源不断的从中涌进我们的星系。
entries.en: A second dimensional portal has appeared in the [second_portal_system.GetName] system. Like the first one, it is continuously bringing hostile extradimensional ships into our galaxy.

entries.zh: 在[third_portal_system.GetName]恒星系发现第三个传送门。它现在正向我们世界的位面传送异次元体的舰船。
entries.en: A third portal has been detected in the [third_portal_system.GetName] system. Even now, it is spewing hostile extradimensional ships into our realm of existence.

entries.zh: 我们已经定位了沃陶姆母恒星系的坐标。
entries.en: We now have the coordinates of the Vultaum home system.

entries.zh: 尤特的古老母星的坐标已最终定位。
entries.en: The ancient homeworld of the Yuht has finally been located.

entries.zh: 哈本尼斯之泽恒星系是远古第一联盟的行政中心和经济中心。
entries.en: The Fen Habbanis system was the political, administrative and economical center of the ancient First League.

entries.zh: 伊拉斯星系是古老的伊拉斯协约国的核心。
entries.en: The Irass system was the heart of the ancient Irassian Concordat.

entries.zh: 赛博勒克斯最后似乎撤离到了这个星系。
entries.en: The Cybrex seem to have retreated to this star system.

entries.zh: 可疑的飞行器停留在这个地点了。我们对他们发起的任何通讯都没有得到回应，现在我们唯有静观其变，看接下来会发生什么。
entries.en: The unusual spacefarers are located here. Any attempts to hail them has been met with silence, so we can only wait and see what happens next.

entries.zh: 入侵者正在建造某种大型空间站，以作“次元锚”之用——有了这些“通道”，便可以增进他们飞船从虫洞中通过的能力。次元锚越多，他们从原次元获得支援的次数就会越多。\n\n这些次元锚似乎还可以有效地增强异次元传送门的亚空间强度。只要有次元锚存在，我们的武器就无法对异次元传送门造成伤害！
entries.en: The invaders are building some kind of large space stations that act as dimensional "anchors" - conduits that increase their ability to move ships through their wormhole. The more of these Anchors they bring online, the more often they will be able to bring in reinforcements from their own realm.\n\nThese Anchors also appear to significantly strengthen the subspace integrity of the Dimensional Portal. The Portal will effectively be invulnerable to weapons as long as there are any active Anchors!

entries.zh: 出现了第二阵营的异次元入侵者开始出现在我们星系，攻击意愿不逊于之前一波。幸运的是，两支异次元体部队似乎也打起来了。
entries.en: A second faction of extradimensional invaders has appeared in our galaxy, no less hostile than the previous one. Fortunately, the extradimensionals seem to be fighting each other as well.

entries.zh: 来自另一个虫洞的三号阵营异次元部队出现了。他们也有意吞噬这个星系中的所有生物，但目前已与前两波入侵者陷入了苦战。
entries.en: A third extradimensional faction has emerged from yet another wormhole. Although they are also intent on consuming all life in our galaxy, they seem to be engaged in some kind of three-way war with the other factions from their dimension.

entries.zh: 我们得知，在这些坐标点处可能有先驱文明留下的文物或重要信息。
entries.en: It has been brought to our attention that there may be artifacts or important information regarding a Precursor civilization at these coordinates.

entries.zh: 在§L[precursor_planet.GetName]§!发现了有关先驱的新异常现象。
entries.en: A new Precursor anomaly has been discovered on §L[precursor_planet.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 一小队来自§Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§!的民用飞船到达了我们的国境，其中载满了§Y[Root.GetSpeciesName]§!难民。他们被准许在§H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!安家。\n\n这些不幸的流放者被[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国强迫赶走出了自己的家园。自那之后，他们便四处流浪，孤注一掷地想要在物资耗尽前找到新的家园。
entries.en: A flotilla of civilian transports carrying §Y[Root.GetSpeciesName]§! refugees from the §Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§! have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on §H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!.\n\nThese unfortunate outcasts were forcefully expelled from their homes by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities. They have been traveling from system to system since then, in a desperate attempt to find new homes before the last of their dwindling supplies were used up.

entries.zh: 一小队来自§Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§!的破败民用飞船到达了我们的领域，其中载满了§Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!难民。在我们提供了食物和医疗后，这些难民被准许在§H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!安家。\n\n这些狼狈恐慌的难民是逃离[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国肃清的幸存者。多亏了一些紧急召集起来的地面下的一伙和同情他们的商船舰长才逃了出来。
entries.en: A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying §Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! fleeing from the §Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§! have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on §H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!.\n\nThese ragged and frightened refugees are survivors from the extermination program being carried out by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities against their species. They only made it out thanks to the efforts of a hastily organized underground railroad and a few sympathetic merchant skippers.

entries.zh: 一支的破败民船舰队，满载着逃离§Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§!的§Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!，已经抵达了我们的境内。在我们提供了食物和医疗后，这些难民被准许在§H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!安家。\n\n这些狼狈恐慌的难民是[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesAdj]无情攻势下的幸存者。多亏他们冒险从星球上一处旧军港里偷了几艘废弃太空船才逃了出来。
entries.en: A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying §Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! fleeing from the §Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§! have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on §H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!.\n\nThese ragged and frightened refugees are survivors of onslaught carried out by the merciless [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesAdj] mind. They only made it out thanks to a daring theft of several decommissioned spacefaring vessels stored in an old naval yard on their planet.

entries.zh: 一支伤痕累累的民用小舰队搭载着躲避§Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§!的§Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!，刚刚抵达了我们的星系。在我们提供食物与医疗救援之后，避难者们获准在§H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!上安家。\n\n这些衣衫褴褛而且惊慌不已的避难者们正在躲避[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]星系内的§H[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetName]§!的蹂躏。他们勉强在[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetSpeciesAdj]的攻势抵达其母星§H[RefugeeEscapedPlanet.GetName]§!之前仓皇逃了出来，将大部分个人财物都留在了那颗注定要覆灭的星球上。
entries.en: A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying §Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! fleeing from the §Y[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]§! have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on §H[Root.Planet.GetName]§!.\n\nThese ragged and frightened refugees are fleeing the ravages of the §H[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetName]§! in [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] space. They just barely managed to escape their home planet of §H[RefugeeEscapedPlanet.GetName]§! before the [RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetSpeciesAdj] onslaught reached it, leaving most of their personal possessions behind on the doomed world.

entries.zh: 有些东西正在破土而出感染我们的殖民地！
entries.en: Something is burrowing out of the ground and infesting our colony!
